description: This file implements a route base component for managing socket listeners, accepting client connections, handling message dispatch, and sending messages in a distributed messaging system. It includes functions for binding and closing listeners, accepting clients, sending messages, and starting a routing instance with an event loop.

methods.name: rtError rtRouteBase_CloseListener(rtListener * pListener)
methods.description: Closes a given rtListener object by shutting down and closing its socket, then logging the action.

methods.name: rtError rtRouteBase_BindListener(char const * socket_name,int no_delay,int indefinite_retry,rtListener ** pListener)
methods.description: Creates and binds a listening socket based on a socket name with specified options for no delay and retry behavior, sets socket options, listens, and returns the listener object.

methods.name: rtError _rtdirect_send_reply_to_client(rtConnectedClient * client,rtMessageHeader * request_hdr,const uint8_t * rspData,uint32_t rspDataLength)
methods.description: Encodes and sends a response message to a connected client based on the message header and response data provided.

methods.name: void _rtdirect_prepare_reply_from_request(rtMessageHeader * reply,const rtMessageHeader * request)
methods.description: Prepares a reply message header based on an original request message header by copying fields and swapping topics.

methods.name: void _rtdirect_route_thread_specific_key()
methods.description: Initializes a pthread thread-specific key for direct routing context.

methods.name: rtError _rtdirect_OnMessage(rtConnectedClient * sender,rtMessageHeader * hdr,uint8_t const * buff,int n,rtSubscription * mySubs)
methods.description: Handles incoming messages from clients, processes subscription requests or forwards messages via a registered callback.

methods.name: void _rtdirect_pushFd(fd_set * fds,int fd,int * maxFd)
methods.description: Adds a file descriptor to a fd_set for select monitoring and updates the maximum fd.

methods.name: void _rtdirect_dispatch_message_from_client(rtConnectedClient * clnt,rtRouteEntry * pDirectRoute)
methods.description: Dispatches a received message to the appropriate handler, performing routing and logging.

methods.name: void rtConnectedClient_Init(rtConnectedClient * clnt,int fd,struct sockaddr_storage * remote_endpoint)
methods.description: Initializes a rtConnectedClient structure with socket and remote endpoint details, allocates buffers and initializes header.

methods.name: void rtConnectedClient_Reset(rtConnectedClient * clnt)
methods.description: Resets the client read state and header for the next message.

methods.name: rtError rtConnectedClient_Read(rtConnectedClient * clnt,rtRouteEntry * myDirectRoute)
methods.description: Reads data from a client socket, processes message framing, and dispatches complete messages.

methods.name: rtConnectedClient * rtRouteDirect_RegisterNewClient(int fd,struct sockaddr_storage * remote_endpoint)
methods.description: Registers a new client connection, initializes client structure, and logs identification.

methods.name: rtConnectedClient * rtRouteDirect_AcceptClientConnection(rtListener * listener)
methods.description: Accepts an incoming connection on a listener socket and registers it as a new client.

methods.name: rtError rtRouteDirect_SendMessage(const rtPrivateClientInfo * pClient,uint8_t const * pInBuff,int inLength,uint32_t subscriptionId,bool rawData)
methods.description: Constructs and sends a message to a specified client, encoding message headers and handling errors.

methods.name: rtError rtRouteDirect_StartInstance(const char * socket_name,rtDriectClientHandler messageHandler)
methods.description: Starts a direct routing server instance, binds to a socket, creates a route, and enters an event loop to accept and handle client connections.
